about:
Northwest Arkansas Sheet Metal has operated from Rogers, Arkansas since the early 1950s. The company was founded to serve the region's emerging construction industry, though no founders or ownership structure are disclosed.

The firm functions as a commercial contractor, fabricating and installing HVAC ductwork systems and providing industrial welding services. Its shop also offers CADD and BIM modeling, CAD services, and custom welding. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed.

Primary customers are in commercial construction, HVAC, and industrial sectors across the South-Central United States. The company references work on projects throughout Northwest Arkansas and the broader region.

The original description notes that quality and good business practices were combined with the high personal values characteristic of the area's "bible belt" mentality, a philosophy that continues to guide its approach.
